messages:
sasha: Sharing the compact credential list mock in Figma — trying a denser layout for teams with lots of tokens. link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/cred-compact
aj: Nice! Quick q: where does rotate live in this layout? I can't see affordance for inline rotation without expanding a row.
meera: Good call. I pushed a variant where actions appear on hover as a kebab menu, but that hides key rotation from keyboard users.
ryan: Hover-only is a11y no-no. Can we surface actions as a focusable button per row? Minimal visual noise but keyboard reachable.
jamie: Agree with ryan. Also, we should show scope label chips right in the list, truncated, with tooltip on hover. That helps surface permissions earlier.
olivia: Microcopy thought — for revoked tokens, use "revoked on <date> — view history" vs current "revoked" badge. Gives context.
sasha: Love the context idea. Also debating soft-revoke vs hard-revoke copy. If we allow a grace period, copy needs to be explicit. Draft: "Revoked (grace period: 24 hours). Requests will be rejected after 24h." Thoughts?
aj: Shorter: "Revoked — 24h grace before rejection." But not sure "revoked" + "grace" confuses users. Maybe "Pending disable (24h)"?
meera: UX nit: confirmation modal for revoke currently says "Are you sure?" Need intent-based copy: "Disable this credential now? This will stop new requests immediately; existing sessions may continue until their token expiry."
ryan: +1 for explicit effects. Also add an aria-live region for the server response after revoke so screen readers get feedback.
a11y-bot: Accessibility check: Ensure revoke CTA is not the only red control; include descriptive text for color-blind users. Contrast pass for red button: 4.5:1? (auto-check warns 3.9:1)
olj: (typo: should be olivia)
olivia: oops typo in my earlier message, thanks. Re: contrast, we should use an icon + text and a strong outline fallback.
jamie: On the create flow — can we show recommended TTL presets (1h, 24h, 90d) with one-line tradeoffs? Default to project policy if org has enforcement.
sasha: Yep. Proposal: TTL radio group with inline help: "1h — short-lived, best for workers"; "24h — dev use"; "90d — long-lived, rotate regularly". Also add tooltip: "Org policy may override."
aj: For bulk revoke, UX needs to avoid mistakes: two-step bulk confirm with keyword entry? Feels heavyweight. Maybe checkbox + brief summary + undo link for 15 minutes.
meera: Undo link is friendlier. We can soft-delete and show a dismissible banner: "N credentials disabled — Undo". Add audit log entry too.
olivia: What about the empty state for projects with no tokens? Current mock is just a CTA. Suggest adding starter recipes: "Create service token" and "Create developer token" with one-line examples. Helps onboarding.
ryan: Keyboard flow check: after creating a token, focus should move to the newly-created key card and the "copy" button should be focused. Otherwise mouse-only users get stuck.
sasha: Good catch — I'll wire that into the prototype. Also need to ensure the copy-to-clipboard announces success via aria-live.
a11y-bot: Reminder: ensure the token reveal toggle uses aria-pressed and has an accessible name like "Show token value" and that the value is in a role=textbox with readonly attribute for screen readers.
jamie: One tiny copy nit for rotate confirmation: current text "Rotate key now?" -> change to "Rotate credential now? Existing tokens will stop working immediately unless replaced."
aj: Final ask from devs: can we limit the number of inline icons? Rendering many icons in compact mode hurts perf on mobile. Consider using text-only in the smallest breakpoint.
sasha: Noted. I'll make two density breakpoints: compact (desktop) and condensed (mobile). Thanks for the rapid feedback — I'll push an updated Figma with the changes and ping again. :sparkles:
